name: Mimi Nezumi
source:
In this short visual novel, you play as Mimi, a little mouse who decides to venture outside of her home in the ceiling of a house. Your decisions will determine the outcome of Mimi's adventure, and there are 6 endings in total.

[From [URL=http://www.renai.us/game/mimi-nezumi.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/URL]]
